card_overclock.name: OVERCLOCK
card_overclock.description: Increases the lower die by +1 on non-natural double rolls (Max 6).

card_synchronize.name: SYNCHRONIZE
card_synchronize.description: If non-double dice are consecutive, lower die increases by +1 (e.g., 5-4 → 5-5). Only 2 moves played.

card_convergence.name: CONVERGENCE
card_convergence.description: If non-double dice differ by at least 3, lower die gets +2 and higher die gets −1 (e.g., 6-1 → 5-3).

card_cold_reboot.name: COLD REBOOT
card_cold_reboot.description: If raw dice sum is 5 or lower, optionally reroll both dice once.

card_double_tuner.name: DOUBLE TUNER
card_double_tuner.description: On natural double x-x, replaces 4 identical values with [x−1, x, x, x+1].

card_doubles_engine.name: DOUBLES ENGINE
card_doubles_engine.description: On natural doubles, allows using the die value 5 times instead of 4.

card_compression_field.name: COMPRESSION FIELD
card_compression_field.description: If opponent non-double dice differ by at least 3, higher die gets −2, lower die gets +1 (e.g., 6-1 → 4-2).

card_overvoltage_trip.name: OVERVOLTAGE TRIP
card_overvoltage_trip.description: If opponent non-double dice sum is 10 or higher, forces opponent dice to automatically reroll.

card_double_fault.name: DOUBLE FAULT
card_double_fault.description: When opponent rolls a natural double, grants them only 3 moves instead of 4.

card_six_tax.name: SIX TAX
card_six_tax.description: When opponent rolls a 6 on a non-double roll, their other die gets −1 (Min 1).

card_mirror_reflex.name: MIRROR REFLEX
card_mirror_reflex.description: When your blot is hit, the hitting opponent checker is also sent to the Bar.

card_shatter_blot.name: SHATTER BLOT
card_shatter_blot.description: When you hit an opponent blot, an adjacent opponent blot directly ahead also gets sent to the Bar.

card_double_tap.name: DOUBLE TAP
card_double_tap.description: After your first hit in a turn, any unused die gets +1 (Max 6).

card_open_circuit.name: OPEN CIRCUIT
card_open_circuit.description: If you end your turn with at least one open blot, your lower die gets +1 on your next non-double roll.

card_second_wind.name: SECOND WIND
card_second_wind.description: When one of your blots is hit, your lower die gets +1 on your next turn (Max 6).

card_deflection.name: DEFLECTION
card_deflection.description: When your blot is hit, instead of going to the Bar, it retreats 1 point backward if possible.

card_compulsory_hit.name: COMPULSORY HIT
card_compulsory_hit.description: If opponent has any legal move sequence containing a hit, they MUST perform at least one hit.

card_blood_tax.name: BLOOD TAX
card_blood_tax.description: After opponent makes their first hit in a turn, their next die gets −1 (Min 1).

card_double_fracture.name: DOUBLE FRACTURE
card_double_fracture.description: When opponent makes a hit during a double roll, 1 remaining die move is destroyed.

card_backlash.name: BACKLASH
card_backlash.description: After opponent makes their first hit in a turn, the hitting checker retreats 1 point backward if possible.

card_blood_magnet.name: BLOOD MAGNET
card_blood_magnet.description: If opponent starts their turn with at least one blot and has valid moves, their first move MUST move a blot.

card_cowards_tax.name: COWARD'S TAX
card_cowards_tax.description: If opponent has at least one legal hit opportunity during their turn but chooses not to hit, their lower die gets −1 on their next turn.

card_magnetic_link.name: MAGNETIC LINK
card_magnetic_link.description: If a move ends exactly 1 point behind your own blot, it automatically advances +1 to form a point/gate.

card_repulsor.name: REPULSOR
card_repulsor.description: If opponent moves onto their own blot to form a new point, the landing checker is pushed +1 forward, preventing point creation.

card_counterstrike.name: COUNTERSTRIKE
card_counterstrike.description: When re-entering from the Bar and hitting an opponent blot, any unused die gets +1 (Max 6).

card_launchpad.name: LAUNCHPAD
card_launchpad.description: When re-entering from the Bar onto your own blot to form a point, any unused die gets +1 (Max 6).

card_failsafe.name: FAILSAFE
card_failsafe.description: If you cannot re-enter any checker from the Bar for an entire turn, your lower die gets +1 on your next turn.

card_batch_upload.name: BATCH UPLOAD
card_batch_upload.description: If you start your turn with exactly 2 checkers on the Bar and roll a non-double with valid entry, both checkers re-enter together using 1 die.

card_bypass_protocol.name: BYPASS PROTOCOL
card_bypass_protocol.description: If you have checkers on the Bar but your dice cannot re-enter them, Bar priority is suspended and you may move checkers on the board.

card_bar_static.name: BAR STATIC
card_bar_static.description: If opponent starts their turn with 2 or more checkers on the Bar, their higher die gets −1 before resolving entries.

card_black_ice.name: BLACK ICE
card_black_ice.description: If an opponent checker ends its move on the icy point designated at match start, it is instantly sent to the Bar.

card_packet_drop.name: PACKET DROP
card_packet_drop.description: After playing 1 die on a non-double roll, you may discard the remaining die and end your turn.

card_lost_packet.name: LOST PACKET
card_lost_packet.description: If opponent cannot play one of their dice and ends turn early, their lower die gets −1 on their next turn.

card_echo_jam.name: ECHO JAM
card_echo_jam.description: If opponent uses both dice on the same checker on a non-double turn, the second die gets −1 (Min 1).

card_forced_commit.name: FORCED COMMIT
card_forced_commit.description: If opponent plays their first die on a checker and the second die can also be played on the same checker, they MUST play it on the same checker.

card_redundancy.name: REDUNDANCY
card_redundancy.description: When all checkers are in your home board and one die cannot be played at all, the playable die can be used twice.

card_home_security.name: HOME SECURITY
card_home_security.description: If opponent has at least one open blot in their home board, they cannot bear off checkers.

card_final_check.name: FINAL CHECK
card_final_check.description: Opponent cannot bear off their last remaining checker with overshoot (excess die). Must be an exact die roll.

card_exact_lock.name: EXACT LOCK
card_exact_lock.description: Opponent cannot bear off any checkers with overshoot. Checkers can only be borne off on exact die matches.

card_tailwind.name: TAILWIND
card_tailwind.description: The first time you move your rearmost checker each turn, the die used gets +1 (Max 6).

card_trailing_drag.name: TRAILING DRAG
card_trailing_drag.description: The first time opponent moves their rearmost checker each turn, the die used gets −1 (Min 1).

card_courier.name: COURIER
card_courier.description: Your Courier checker designated at match start gets +1 die distance every time it moves (Max 6).

card_deadweight.name: DEADWEIGHT
card_deadweight.description: The opponent Deadweight checker designated at match start gets −1 die distance every time it moves (Min 1).

card_event_horizon.name: EVENT HORIZON
card_event_horizon.description: Every time the opponent bears off a checker, their next roll's lower die gets −1 (Min 1) — gravity intensifies the closer they get to escaping.

card_termination_protocol.name: TERMINATION PROTOCOL
card_termination_protocol.description: OMEGA CORE's own blots can never be hit — its exposed checkers cannot be broken.
